TS LAWCET, PGLCET 2026 counselling dates announced

The counselling schedule for the Telangana State Law Common Entrance Test (TS LAWCET) and Postgraduate Law Common Entrance Test (PGLCET) for the 2026 academic year has been released. This announcement pertains to admissions for LLB and LLM programs in Telangana. Students can now check the complete schedule for the counselling process.
